overview: CTNNs construct canonical spanning tree covers via coverage-aware MST extraction with iterative edge-weight refinement, process each tree with a bidirectional Tree-LSTM augmented by residual-edge message passing, and aggregate across the cover to obtain invariant, expressive graph representations for sparse graph classification.

modules.name: Graph Dataset Loading and Preprocessing
modules.description: Load molecular (MoleculeNet: ClinTox, BACE, BBBP, HIV, PCBA), protein (ProteinShake: SCOP, GO MOL, GO BIO), and brain (NeuroGraph) graph datasets; perform train/val/test splitting with fixed random seeds; normalize node features; construct PyG Data objects with adjacency, features, and labels.

modules.name: Canonical Spanning Tree Cover Construction
modules.description: Implement Algorithm 1 (BUILDCANONICALTREECOVER): initialize edge weights from a node labeler, iteratively extract MSTs across K rounds, update edge weights by penalizing selected edges to promote coverage, terminate early if all edges are covered, and return the set of canonical spanning trees with their roots.

modules.name: Kruskal MST with Exchangeable Tie-Breaking
modules.description: Implement Algorithm 2 (KRUSKALMST): sort edges by lexicographic key of base weight and i.i.d. continuous tie-breaker, scan in nondecreasing order, add edges via union-find if they do not create a cycle, ensuring probabilistic invariance of the resulting spanning tree under graph isomorphism.

modules.name: Canonical Root Selection via Tree Center
modules.description: Implement Algorithm 3 (TREECENTER): perform two BFS passes on the spanning tree to find the endpoints of a longest path, then select the center vertex (or the canonically preferred one of the two centers) as the root, providing a deterministic isomorphism-invariant rooting when combined with a canonical node labeler.

modules.name: Bidirectional Child-Sum Tree-LSTM Encoder
modules.description: Implement Algorithm 4 (BiTreeLSTMForward): compute bottom-up hidden states by aggregating child states via child-sum with per-edge forget gates, then compute top-down hidden states by propagating from parent to children, producing a concatenated bidirectional representation for each node; parallelize computation across depth levels.

modules.name: Residual Graph MPNN Module
modules.description: Implement message passing on the residual graph (original edges minus tree edges) for each spanning tree in the cover, using an injective aggregator (e.g., GIN-style sum) to capture local connectivity not represented in the tree structure.

modules.name: TreeMPNN Layer
modules.description: Combine the bidirectional Tree-LSTM encoder output with the residual-graph MPNN output via element-wise addition at the node level, yielding a per-node representation that integrates both hierarchical tree structure and local non-tree connectivity.

modules.name: CTNN Full Model Architecture
modules.description: Assemble the complete CTNN model: given an input graph, construct the canonical spanning tree cover, process each tree through the TreeMPNN layer, compute a graph-level representation per tree via root-state readout, and aggregate across all K trees using a permutation-invariant multiset aggregator (sum) to produce the final invariant graph embedding for classification.

modules.name: Probabilistic and Deterministic Invariance Mechanism
modules.description: Implement the dual invariance framework: (1) probabilistic invariance using inexpensive structurally meaningful node labelers (degree, centrality, 1-WL) with random tie-breaking, producing an isomorphism-invariant distribution over tree covers; (2) deterministic invariance using canonical node labelers (NAUTY/BLISS) that uniquely separate all nodes, yielding an identical tree cover for isomorphic graphs.

modules.name: Training Pipeline and Optimization
modules.description: Implement the full training loop: binary cross-entropy loss for binary tasks and negative log-likelihood for multiclass tasks, Adam optimizer with grid-searched hyperparameters (learning rate, weight decay, batch size, hidden dimension), early stopping with patience on validation performance, and epoch-level checkpointing.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Computation
modules.description: Implement all evaluation metrics used in the paper: AUC-ROC for molecular and protein binary benchmarks, classification accuracy for multiclass protein (SCOP) and brain benchmarks, empirical stretch and contraction for distance distortion analysis, and edge coverage fraction for tree cover quality assessment.

modules.name: Baseline Model Implementations
modules.description: Implement or integrate all baseline models for comparison: invariant MPNNs (GCN, GAT, GIN), expressive GNNs (GT, RWSE, GSN, ESAN), and sequence-based canonicalization approaches (Fingerprint+MLP, SMILES+RNN/Transformer, Primary Sequence+RNN, DGCNN with SortPooling, RCM ordering+RNN).

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Implement systematic ablation variants of CTNN: (1) Single tree vs. cover (K=1), isolating the effect of multiple trees on coverage and expressivity; (2) MPNN-only (replacing Tree-LSTM with GIN on each tree), isolating the benefit of tree-structured recurrence; (3) TreeRNN-only (removing residual MPNN), isolating the contribution of non-tree edge message passing.

modules.name: Sensitivity Analysis Module
modules.description: Implement hyperparameter sensitivity sweeps: number of trees K (coverage-distortion-accuracy tradeoff), coverage penalty τ, node labeler πV (degree, closeness centrality, BLISS), and sequence encoder type for SMILES baselines (LSTM vs. Transformer). Report coverage, distortion, and task performance across configurations.

modules.name: Distortion Analysis and UST Comparison
modules.description: Compute and compare empirical distortion metrics between CTNN tree covers and uniform spanning tree (UST) samples: measure expected stretch and contraction over tree distributions, validate that CTNN's coverage-aware MST construction achieves lower distortion than independent UST samples, and visualize distortion as a function of K.

modules.name: Result Aggregation, Reporting, and Reproducibility
modules.description: Aggregate results across five random data splits, compute median (min, max) performance following the paper's protocol, generate LaTeX tables matching the paper format (Tables 1-3, 5-9), produce sensitivity and distortion figures (Figures 5, 7), log preprocessing runtimes per graph, and manage configuration files for full experiment reproducibility.
